# HandleGrantTo

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

HandleGrant() that stores the target's handle value in `out`.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
Err HandleGrantTo(Handle h, Handle target_space_handle, HandlePerms perms, Handle *out);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) to grant. |
| `target_space_handle` | in | Space to receive it, with PERM_CNTL. |
| `perms` | in | Permissions for the copy. |
| `out` | out | Receives the handle's value in the target; may be NULL. |

## Returns

As HandleGrant().
